column1: # Sites each node checks every hour (host/vessel-reach.py): id, address, and text only the
# real page has, so a challenge or a block page that answers 200 is not taken for the site. The ids are the names in
# web/src/i18n/*.json (reach.site.<id>). Sites that challenge curl from anywhere (Cloudflare's "Just a moment") are left
# out: a check without a browser cannot tell them apart from a block. WhatsApp's home page answers 400 to anything but a
# browser, so its robots.txt stands in for the site.
